verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid is a built-in AI assistant accessible via App, terminal (CLI), and API, to which users delegate tasks (e.g., implementing mockups, running readiness reports/fixes, executing missions) and review/merge results — this is core to the product's design across multiple first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and concrete real-world examples of delegation outcomes.
